newsitem.title: USA: AES Corp improves AES China merger offer.
newsitem.headline: AES Corp improves AES China merger offer.

text.p: AES Corp said on Thursday it is sweetening its offer to Class A shareholders of AES China Generating Co Ltd by removing the possibility that the exchange ratio in the proposed merger would be revised downward.

AES China shareholders were offered 0.29 shares of AES stock for each AES China share. Even though AES Corp's stock has risen since the proposal was made, the ratio will not be revised downward, so AES China shareholders now could possibly receive more than the original $14.50 per share.
The merger must be approved by the shareholders.
